# Systemia Atlas Freight Load Exception Intelligence

Product key: systemia-atlas-freight
Aliases: Systemia Atlas
Canonical product: https://base44.app/api/apps/69455b200bffe3a07c7bb042/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-atlas-freight/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-atlas-freight/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- what is wrong with this load
- audit this freight load for exceptions
- check this carrier and load paperwork
- find missing POD or rate mismatches
- summarize freight risk on this shipment
- what recoverable charges or detention issues exist

## Authority

public discovery of read-only freight exception intelligence within authorized organization scope

## Boundaries

- no approved machine price or payment path is verified
- analysis does not authorize dispatch, quote acceptance, carrier contact, claim filing, payment or invoice action
- financial impact is reported only when supported by recorded evidence
- organization-scoped or private freight records remain access controlled

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
